title: The Brave Man's Bridge
text: A bridge of a single rope spans the gorge, fraying where it rubs the rock. Far below, white water thunders over stones. A sign hangs from the post: ONLY THE BRAVE MAY CROSS. THE REST MUST SWIM. Someone has drawn a skull beside it.

options.label: The bravest crosses the rope and makes it fast, so the rest may follow.

outcomes.text: A second rope, then a third. Everyone crosses dry, with the water roaring hungrily below.
The rope snaps halfway, and the water takes them, and spits them out on the rocks, broken.

options.label: Swim the white water, and leave the rope to the brave and the foolish.

outcomes.text: Cold to the bone, wet, and slower, and the river does not want to let go.

options.label: Burn the bridge behind you, so that nothing can follow.

outcomes.text: You swim, cursing the cold, but nothing follows you across. Whatever was behind you will have to find its own way.
